/**
 * public/js/app.js - DOCUMENTATION
 * ==================================
 * Main application logic for Shipping with Purpose website
 * 
 * NOTE: This file is MINIFIED (production build)
 * Do not edit this file directly. Edit the source and rebuild.
 * No source file available - this is what runs in production
 *
 * PURPOSES & FEATURES:
 * 1. API Request Handler - Fetch with fallback chain
 * 2. Navigation - Hamburger menu toggle for mobile
 * 3. Animations - Fade-in sections on scroll (Intersection Observer)
 * 4. Print Portal Form - File upload and submission
 * 5. Mailbox Quote Builder - Price calculation and reservation form
 * 6. Reservation Drawer - Modal for mailbox booking
 *
 * ============================================================
 * 1. API REQUEST HANDLER
 * ============================================================
 * 
 * Function: apiRequest(endpoint, fetchOptions)
 * Purpose: Make HTTP requests with intelligent fallback
 *
 * Tries endpoints in order:
 * 1. /api/... (same origin - local backend on same host)
 * 2. http://localhost:3000/api/... (Node.js backend)
 * 3. https://srt-swp.p-vedant7878.workers.dev/api/... (Cloudflare Worker)
 *
 * Example usage:
 *   const result = await apiRequest('/print-request', {
 *     method: 'POST',
 *     body: formData,
 *   });
 *
 * Returns: Parsed JSON response
 * Throws: Error if all endpoints fail
 *
 * Important: Only accepts application/json responses
 * Rate limits applied server-side (30 prints, 60 reservations per 10 min)
 *
 * ============================================================
 * 2. NAVIGATION - HAMBURGER MENU
 * ============================================================
 * 
 * Function: initNav()
 * Purpose: Set up mobile hamburger menu toggle
 *
 * Elements:
 * - #hamburger: Button that toggles menu
 * - #mobile-menu: Container for mobile nav menu
 *
 * Behavior:
 * - Hamburger click toggles nav__menu--open class on #mobile-menu
 * - Icon swaps between menu.svg and close.svg
 * - aria-expanded attribute updated for accessibility
 * - Clicking nav links closes menu automatically
 * - Only initialized once (data-navInitialized flag)
 *
 * Called on:
 * - Page load (initNav())
 * - After components loaded (document.addEventListener('components:loaded', initNav))
 *
 * ============================================================
 * 3. ANIMATIONS - FADE-IN ON SCROLL
 * ============================================================
 * 
 * Elements: .fade-section
 * Purpose: Fade in sections as they come into view
 *
 * Behavior:
 * - Watches all .fade-section elements
 * - When 8% of element is visible, adds .visible class
 * - Smooth CSS transition triggers fade-in effect
 * - Each element unobserved after first intersection (one-time animation)
 *
 * CSS:
 * - .fade-section { opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s; }
 * - .fade-section.visible { opacity: 1; }
 *
 * ============================================================
 * 4. PRINT PORTAL FORM
 * ============================================================
 * 
 * Elements:
 * - #print-portal-form: Main form
 * - #drop-zone: Drag & drop area for files
 * - #file-input: Hidden file input
 * - #uploaded-doc-list: Display area for uploaded files
 * - #uploaded-doc-empty: Empty state message
 * - #print-portal-feedback: Error/success messages
 * - #portal-name: Name input field
 * - #portal-copies: Copy count input field
 *
 * Features:
 * - Drag & drop file upload
 * - File picker via click on drop-zone
 * - File validation: type, size, count
 * - Display uploaded files as list
 * - Name field (required)
 * - Print type: Black & White vs Color
 * - Copies: 1-10000 (validated)
 * - Special instructions (optional)
 * - Show/hide empty state based on files
 *
 * Validation:
 * - Min 1 file required
 * - Max 10 files
 * - Max 25MB total size
 * - Allowed types: PDF, DOC, DOCX, PNG, JPEG
 * - Name required
 * - Copies 1-10000
 *
 * Submission:
 * - POST /api/print-request (with fallback chain)
 * - Multipart form data with file attachments
 * - Shows feedback message on success/error
 *
 * ============================================================
 * 5. MAILBOX QUOTE BUILDER
 * ============================================================
 * 
 * Data source: public/data/mailbox-content.json
 * Purpose: Interactive pricing calculator for mailbox rentals
 *
 * Features:
 * - Select box size (Personal, Standard, Large, Extra Large)
 * - Select rental term (1-Month, 3-Month, 6-Month, 12-Month)
 * - Optional add-ons (Mail notifications, etc.)
 * - Real-time price calculation
 * - Display quote summary
 * - "Reserve Now" button to open reservation form
 *
 * Calculation:
 * - Base price for box size + term combination
 * - Add monthly cost of any selected add-ons
 * - Display total monthly cost
 *
 * ============================================================
 * 6. RESERVATION DRAWER/MODAL
 * ============================================================
 * 
 * Purpose: Collect mailbox reservation request data
 *
 * Form fields:
 * - Name (required)
 * - Company/LLC (optional)
 * - Phone (required)
 * - Email (required, validated)
 * - Mailbox Type (from quote builder)
 * - Rental Term (from quote builder)
 * - Mail Notifications (optional checkbox)
 *
 * Submission:
 * - POST /api/reservation-request (with fallback chain)
 * - JSON payload with form data
 * - Confirmation email sent via Resend API
 * - Success message or error handling
 *
 * ============================================================
 * GLOBAL CONSTANTS
 * ============================================================
 * 
 * SYSTEM_LOCKOUT: Boolean - if true, prevents some features
 * API_TARGETS: Array - fallback API endpoints
 * (See API REQUEST section above)
 *
 * ============================================================
 * SECURITY NOTES
 * ============================================================
 * 
 * - User input sanitized server-side
 * - File uploads validated on both client and server
 * - Rate limiting enforced server-side
 * - Resend API credentials never exposed in client code
 * - CORS headers set server-side for API requests
 *
 * ============================================================
 * BROWSER COMPATIBILITY
 * ============================================================
 * 
 * Requires:
 * - Fetch API (ES6+, modern browsers)
 * - Intersection Observer API (modern browsers)
 * - ES6 classes and arrow functions (minified production code)
 *
 * Fallbacks:
 * - Polyfills may be needed for older IE 11
 *
 * ============================================================
 * DEBUGGING
 * ============================================================
 * 
 * Common issues:
 * 1. Files not uploading: Check browser console for validation errors
 * 2. API failing: Check Network tab - see which endpoint succeeds
 * 3. Menu not appearing: Ensure #hamburger and #mobile-menu IDs exist
 * 4. Fade animations not working: Check .fade-section CSS classes
 * 5. Quote not calculating: Verify mailbox-content.json is loading (Network tab)
 *
 * To debug:
 * - Open browser DevTools (F12)
 * - Watch Network tab for API calls
 * - Check Console for JavaScript errors
 * - Use Chrome DevTools' source map viewer if available
 *
 * ============================================================
 * DEPENDENCIES
 * ============================================================
 * 
 * External libraries:
 * - Swiper.js (via vendor/swiper-bundle.min.js) - for carousels
 *
 * APIs:
 * - Fetch API - HTTP requests
 * - Intersection Observer API - scroll animations
 * - FormData API - file uploads
 *
 * Data files:
 * - public/data/mailbox-content.json - pricing data
 * - public/reviews.json - testimonials (used by Swiper)
 *
 * ============================================================
 * CALLING SEQUENCE
 * ============================================================
 * 
 * 1. Page loads (index.html, mailboxes.html, etc.)
 * 2. app.js script tag executes
 * 3. initNav() called immediately (sets up hamburger)
 * 4. Fade-in animations initialized
 * 5. Print form handler attached
 * 6. Quote builder event listeners attached
 * 7. components.js runs (fetches header/footer)
 * 8. 'components:loaded' event dispatched
 * 9. initNav() called again (for freshly loaded header)
 * 10. highlightActiveNavLink() called (marks current page link)
 * 11. User interacts: upload files, submit forms, click nav, etc.
 *
 * ============================================================
 * MODIFICATION GUIDE
 * ============================================================
 * 
 * Important: This file is minified. To modify:
 * 1. Contact original developer for source files
 * 2. Or carefully search for function names in DevTools
 * 3. Test thoroughly - minified code is fragile to edit
 * 4. Recommended: Work with unminified source if available
 *
 * Common edits (search for these strings):
 * - API_TARGETS: Add/change API fallback URLs
 * - MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES: Change file upload size limit (25mb)
 * - allowedMimeTypes: Add/remove supported file types
 * - Rate limit: Needs server-side change (see server/routes/)
 *
 * ============================================================
 */
